name: mx_record_action_trigger
why: The matrix drives a bare model loop (no delivery/verdict guards),
so its build scores measure the model, not the assistant. This row
sends the same prompt through chat_turn and grades the delivered
playbook with the SAME ir_assertions (`behaves`), plus that the turn
actually delivered it. The prompt must stay equal to the task's

steps.user: Author a FortiSOAR playbook with a record_action trigger on the alerts module (right-click 'Triage Alert' button, one run per record). Read severity from `vars.input.records[0]` into a variable, decide High/Critical vs anything else, and on the high branch stamp a `verdict` variable of 'escalate'; the low branch ends. Output complete YAML.
